name: vlm_vacuolization_index
description: Detects the presence of cytoplasmic vacuoles (holes in the cytoplasmic staining), often a sign of cellular stress or death.
segmentation_prompt: Segment individual cells to inspect cytoplasm for voids.
method_rationale: Vacuoles appear as voids which can be confused with background in code, but context helps VLM identify them.
